nameEn: Manufacture of jewellery and related articles
description: This class includes the manufacture of jewellery and related articles of precious metals and precious or semi-precious stones.
includes: manufacture of jewellery of precious metal or rolled precious metal: rings, bracelets, necklaces, brooches, earrings
manufacture of goldsmith and silversmith wares of precious metal: tableware, cutlery, toilet articles
engraving and chasing of metals for jewellery
manufacture of articles of natural or cultured pearls, precious or semi-precious stones
manufacture of worked precious and semi-precious stones
excludes: cutting and polishing of precious stones, see 0893
